name: invoice-scan
desc: Free, open-source invoice and receipt scanner for Windows — fields to CSV locally, batch folders, no SaaS. 100 MB portable, MIT.
features: ✅ **Field extraction** — vendor, date, total, tax and currency pulled from photos and PDFs locally
✅ **Line items table** — invoice rows captured as separate line entries, not lost in a flat summary
✅ **Reconciliation check** — totals verified against line items and tax math, mismatches flagged
✅ **Batch folders** — a quarter of receipts processed into one CSV or Excel sheet
✅ **Duplicate detection** — the same invoice scanned twice gets flagged instead of paid twice
✅ **Column mapping** — output fields renamed and ordered to match your bookkeeping import
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime and OCR engines bundled, portable, offline, MIT
compare: | Feature | **invoice-scan** | Dext | Manual entry | Cloud OCR APIs |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Paid per month | Your evenings | Paid per page |
| Documents stay local | **Yes** | Upload | Yes | Upload
| Line item extraction | **Yes** | Yes | Manual | Partial
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Cloud | N/A | Cloud
faqQ: scan invoices and receipts to Excel on Windows without a subscription?
faqA: Bookkeeping SaaS charges monthly and keeps copies of every invoice, and typing a year of receipts by hand is nobody's plan. invoice-scan extracts fields and line items locally, checks the math and exports your column layout. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline.
s1: Dark bookkeeping view (#121418, emerald #047857): receipt image left with extracted fields highlighted, results table right with vendor, date and total columns, confidence badges.
s2: Reconciliation panel: total mismatch flagged in red between lines sum and printed total, diff chip reading 12.40, open source image action lit.
s3: Batch results: 240 receipts with per-file status, two duplicates flagged, column mapping strip at bottom showing export order, CSV button armed.
